Attached: 1 image

We shipped CapLite, a deterministic gate for our agents' tool calls. Before any send or write runs, it checks that the target (recipient, URL, amount, id) was in the user's own request. If it was not, it blocks and logs. No model in the loop, so zero extra tokens. On 30 injected fixtures, attack success went from 100% to 0%, with 3.3% benign blocks.
https://workloft.ai/ships/caplite-zero-token-injection-gate-2026-11-14.html
